title: Carmel Valley Wine Tour's Premium Package
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Join Carmel Valley’s #1 Wine Tasting Tour! Over 20 years of Carmel Valley Wine Tasting experience!

Start the Day with a scenic ride out to Carmel Valley Village in our luxury and comfortable coaches and trolleys. Don’t confine yourself to a cramped smaller vehicles!

Premium tastings at Carmel Valley's finest wineries complement the wonderful sit down lunches with either Mexican Food or French Bistro. 

A Bottle of Great Local Wine is included. Wine tasting fees at three venues and lunch are included.
